prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-style sprite concept atlas for an original 2D top-down chibi tactical colony-defense game. Keep relative art quality and thickness coherent across all six components. Transparent pixels outside each component. Design A: grounded field military engineering. Warm khaki/beige canvas bags with subtle stitched folds. Pale warm-gray poured concrete wall with chipped beveled edges, a modest olive metal reinforcement strip and bolts. Turret is olive painted steel with a dark gun barrel, canvas-colored ammo box, practical human-operated fortification silhouette. Core is aged olive and warm-gray machinery with brass repair brackets and muted teal center.
